The Thunder Dragon

The full board game, online, for 2 to 6 players — or on your own against two computer players. Pick a Knight, an Archer or a Mage, race across the map, gather the three key fragments, and be the first to bring down Fenrirak.

Single Player

Three at the table, one of each class. You choose first and the computer takes the other two. The ORIGINAL Fenrirak toggle above applies here too.

How it plays

Roll one die and move. Do what your square says. Beat monsters to collect the three key fragments, open the Gate, and bring down Fenrirak in the arena.

  1. 1
    Roll & move One die. Walk that many squares.
  2. 2
    Do the square Draw a card, fight, heal, take coins — it tells you.
  3. 3
    Shop, trade, use your ability Your go is yours. Spend it how you like.
  4. 4
    End your turn And take your hunting roll on the way out.
3 or moreon the die hits, in a fight
attack − defenceis the damage that lands
3 fragmentsopen the Gate to the arena

Land on the same square as another player and you fight them — that part is not optional. Playing on your own is the same game, not a smaller one: the two computer players choose their own gear, weigh up whether a fight is worth having, haggle at the Merchant and decide for themselves how much of a movement bonus they actually want.

Everything in one place — takes a minute.
